data.long_meaning: The name Flanagan is derived from the Irish surname O’Flannaghan, meaning 'descendant of Flann.' Flann is an Old Irish personal name that translates to 'reddish-haired.' Despite its Irish origin, the name has been widely adopted in the English-speaking world and is now commonly used among people of various ethnicities and religious backgrounds.
